channel.title: Edition Compass — new guides
channel.description: Which manga editions exist, from which publisher, and which one to actually buy. A new entry when a new guide goes up.

item.title: Buying manga from Japan — shipping, payment and import tax
item.description: Seven countries can no longer order from Rakuten Ichiba directly. Six of them can still get the books. Norway cannot. What the route costs, and what we could not measure.

item.title: Gintama — the 54 volumes never published in English, and what they cost
item.description: VIZ published 23 of Gintama's 77 volumes in English, then stopped. What the remaining 54 cost new from Japan right now, volume by volume with ISBNs.

item.title: Devilman — every edition, and which one to actually buy
item.description: 18 print editions, 1972–2018. Japanese publishers, volume counts, ISBNs, and what each one costs new and used right now.
